# Kenney Particle Pack

Kenney released [Particle Pack](https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack) under CC0.
The four PNGs and License.txt come from [the author's 2018 download](https://opengameart.org/content/particle-pack-80-sprites).
The raid renderer tints the scorch, twirl, spark and magic sprites for the four runners. Running `npm run assets` in `babylon/` copies the originals to `public/assets/raid/` and records their SHA-256 hashes.
